text:
tom_marketing: Hey team — need a tight one-pager for field: compare security, SLAs, and recommended deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Goal: sales handoff for regulated prospects. 1-pager, single side. Can someone sketch major bullets?
alyssa_product: I can start. high-level ask from AE: compliance posture, data residency, isolation guarantees, and expected latency/throughput ranges.
ben_sales: pls add typical pricing/commit implications under each mode — AEs ask about order-of-magnitude capacity and contract expectations.
maya_ds: include a short note on quantization/accuracy tradeoffs for Dedicated vs Private (customers worry about quality regression with heavy quantization).
tom_marketing: good. prioritize 2-row table: security controls / SLA targets / recommended use-cases. avoid long paragraphs.
alyssa_product: proposed bullets — Hosted: fastest time-to-value, standard encryption at rest/in-transit, shared runtime, 99.9% platform SLA for responses up to 2s p50. Dedicated: isolated GPU pools, tenant network isolation, 99.95% SLA, predictable throughput; bundling options for reserved capacity. Private: full control plane in VPC or on-prem, KMS/HSM integrations, highest compliance (SOC2+), SLA negotiable + professional services for install.
ben_sales: can we add a tiny flowchart suggestion: if customer needs <100qps and strict PD + KMS -> Private; if 100–1k qps and wants predictability -> Dedicated; if prototyping or low compliance -> Hosted.
maya_ds: add note: caching + batching benefits reduce per-token cost for Hosted and Dedicated; Private may need tuning during install. Also one-liner about fallback options (auto-route to compatible variant in outages).
tom_marketing: perfect. I'll draft visuals: left column quick decision flow, center comparison table, right column 3 short customer stories (healthcare pilot, fintech fraud detection, enterprise assistant).
ben_sales: pls include checklist for sales: required compliance docs (DPA, SOC2), network info, expected traffic patterns, and procurement lead time for Dedicated/Private.
alyssa_product: and a tiny FAQ: "Can we mix modes?" -> yes, hybrid routing supported; "What about model versioning?" -> pinning + rollouts supported. Keep it 1-page.
tom_marketing: deadline — draft by EOD today. assigning: alyssa for product copy, ben for sales checklist, maya for technical blurbs.
deploy-bot: file uploaded: /files/2065432199-risk-slas-compare-draft.pdf (preview)
ben_sales: reviewed quick pass — looks good, will add 2 sample contract durations (monthly vs 12/36 mo).
tom_marketing: thanks all. I'll iterate on layout and post updated PDF in #marketing when done. :thumbsup:
